actions: Request relative /api/health through stable front door 5184 from the selected Mac mode.

contract: health includes liveness and schema compatibility
owner: owner/release/instance identity and six-domain readiness are recorded

journeys.name: Owner query
preconditions: Health is verified in the target run and a registered read-only domain operation is selected.
actions: Send a typed query to /api/app/owner through the stable front door without connecting to internal ports.

contract: query keeps contractVersion, domain, operation, revision, and typed error boundaries
owner: authoritative revision and bounded owner payload are recorded without mutation
media: Only identity/reference metadata is allowed if the query includes media

failure.observation: NOT_RUN; no real owner query evidence has been captured.

retry: Repeat the read-only query with the same correlation context after health is ready.
rollback: Do not create a command or write browser persistence when the owner query is unavailable.

evidence.notes: Add 02-owner-query/http.json and owner query evidence from a real run.

journeys.name: Local capability
preconditions: A Windows-local capability such as profile.capability-query or reader-session.query is registered and safe to query.
actions: Issue a capability-query through /api/app/owner and record the exact capability and operation.

http: capability-query travels through stable front door 5184
contract: read-web-local-capabilities.v1 and capability registry are preserved
owner: Local capability has an owner revision and no canonical mutation receipt
media: No media bytes, path, or credential is returned

failure.observation: NOT_RUN; no real local capability request has been captured.

retry: Retry the bounded capability query after the local dependency is ready.
rollback: Mark BLOCKED if the dependency is absent; do not install global dependencies or direct-connect 8776.

evidence.notes: Add 03-local-capability/http.json and capability evidence from a real run.

journeys.name: External capability
preconditions: An approved short external workflow capability and its Windows-side dependency are available.
actions: Submit workflow job-start through the stable front door with an idempotency key, then retain the job identity for polling.

http: job-start returns a stable job identity through 5184
contract: idempotency and typed command outcome are recorded
owner: Owner receipt and external dependency result are recorded separately
media: Only opaque media identity may be returned after the external capability completes

failure.observation: NOT_RUN; no real external capability was invoked.

retry: On commit-unknown, query the original receipt or idempotency identity before any retry.
rollback: Do not claim job completion or create a second operation identity when the dependency is unavailable.

evidence.notes: Add 04-external-capability/http.json, owner receipt, and dependency log from a real run.

journeys.name: Workflow polling
preconditions: A real owner job identity is available from the external capability path or an approved optimization job.
actions: Poll job, queue, and progress through relative /api while recording revisions and visibility changes.

http: Polling remains single-flight and uses relative /api requests
contract: stale revisions are rejected and transport failure is not rendered as job failure
owner: Immutable snapshots and command/receipt associations remain traceable
media: Media remains an identity/reference until a later media probe

failure.observation: NOT_RUN; no real workflow polling sequence has been captured.

retry: Keep the last immutable snapshot and retry under the visibility-aware policy.
rollback: Do not replay a command or change job state when polling transport is unavailable.

evidence.notes: Add 05-workflow-polling/poll-sequence.json and browser/network evidence from a real run.

journeys.name: Audio and video Range
preconditions: Real audio and video media identities with same-origin relative authorized URLs are available.
actions: Issue HEAD and Range bytes=0-0 probes for both audio and video through the stable front door or remote-dev proxy.

http: Audio and video each return 206, Content-Range, Accept-Ranges, and matching ETag
contract: Range semantics and media identity remain within windows-thin-reader-api.v1
owner: Descriptor revision and identity/reference metadata are recorded
media: No signed URL, absolute path, full body, Blob, or ArrayBuffer is used

failure.observation: NOT_RUN; no real audio/video Range response has been captured.

retry: Re-query the descriptor and repeat bounded HEAD/Range probes after the front door is ready.
rollback: Release the old resource on identity or ETag mismatch and return to the last verified descriptor.

evidence.notes: Add 06-media-range/audio-headers.json, video-headers.json, and network evidence from a real run.

journeys.name: Multiple seek positions and media switching
preconditions: The audio/video Range baseline is captured and both media elements can be controlled.
actions: Seek to at least three positions in each media, switch media, refresh binding, and record the subsequent Range requests.

http: Each seek produces bounded Range traffic rather than a full response
contract: Range and ETag rebind rules remain consistent after media switch
owner: Every switch is associated with the current media identity and descriptor revision
media: 206, Content-Range, ETag, and old-URL release are visible in the evidence

failure.observation: NOT_RUN; no real multi-seek or media-switch evidence has been captured.

retry: Stop and release the old element, query the new identity, and repeat the seek after rebind.
rollback: Return to the last verified media identity without changing owner data or using Blob backup.

evidence.notes: Add 07-media-seek-switch/seek-sequence.json and browser network/console evidence from a real run.

journeys.name: Windows restart recovery
preconditions: A real query, job, or media identity has before-restart owner revision and receipt evidence.
actions: Use the approved Windows restart flow, wait for health, and reconnect the Mac to the same stable entry.

http: 5184 is the recovered stable entry and health is available again
owner: Revision, job, media identity, and receipt lookup survive without a second writer
media: Range can be re-bound after restart without returning a full payload

failure.observation: NOT_RUN; no real Windows restart/recovery has been executed.

retry: Keep the pending journal and query the original receipt or authoritative revision before retry.
rollback: If the new release is not ready, restore the previous release/entry without deleting the data root.

evidence.notes: Add 08-windows-restart before/after state, launcher log, and browser evidence from a real run.

journeys.name: Mac reconnect
preconditions: A production or remote-dev Mac session has completed a real health and owner query.
actions: Interrupt and restore the Mac connection, then repeat health, owner query, polling, and one media descriptor/seek query.

http: Production uses the same origin and remote-dev restores the server-side proxy to 5184
contract: relative URLs, original idempotency identity, and receipt lookup remain intact
owner: Windows authoritative revision, receipt, job, and intent state remain authoritative
media: Range and ETag revalidate after reconnect

failure.observation: NOT_RUN; no real Mac reconnect evidence has been captured.

retry: Keep the in-memory intent and last immutable snapshot, show a retry state, and reconnect under the selected mode.
rollback: Never silently write a Mac canonical copy; retain the previous available Windows release if reconnect cannot recover.

evidence.notes: Add 09-mac-reconnect connection sequence, browser network/console, and Windows owner evidence from a real run.
